hints.title: Individual Completion Times
hints.text: Each task completes independently at its start time plus its duration.

hints.title: Single Pass Scan
hints.text: Compute the finish time for each task in a single iteration.

hints.title: Global Minimum Selection
hints.text: Return the minimum value among all computed completion times.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass minimum reduction over start plus duration sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sufficient for any task list size.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Evaluates finish times using constant scalar storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Direct linear scan finding the minimum completion timestamp.
